definitions.explanation: The mature ovary of a flowering plant, typically containing seeds. A formal or technical term for fruit.
Figuratively, the results or rewards of one's efforts or work.

notes:
REGISTER: More formal/technical than ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧.

USAGE DIFFERENCE:
・{果実|かじつ} - botanical/scientific term; includes tomatoes, cucumbers as 'fruits'; also used figuratively
・⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ - everyday word for edible sweet fruits

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{果実|かじつ}⟦{酒|しゅ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (fruit wine/liqueur)
・{果実|かじつ}⟦ジュース→ジュース：09772_juusu⟧ (fruit juice)
・⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧{果実|かじつ} (dried fruit)

FIGURATIVE USE:
・⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果実|かじつ} (fruits of one's labor)
・⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果実|かじつ} (fruits of research)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ (fruit - everyday word)
・⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧ (fruit, nut - native Japanese word)
・フルーツ (fruit - loanword, often for fresh fruit)
